Photo 1 shows the top of the same box, with a black lid and a metal handle.
The box appears worn, with tape damage and scuff marks.
The text 'Xiaomi' and 'Curved Gaming Monitor 30"' are visible on the side in photo 1.

No text or label on the box mentions refresh rate. The box does not show model or specs that confirm 200Hz.

risks.proof: Photo of the monitor's bezel or settings menu showing aspect ratio, or a clear side view showing screen curvature and width.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard 16:9 or 21:9 monitor, not as ultra-wide 21.9:1.

risks.risk: Monitor may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the monitor turned on, showing full screen and no dead pixels, or a video of it in use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown condition.

risks.risk: Box may be empty or contain a different model
risks.proof: Photo of the monitor itself, showing brand, model, and screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified, with lower value due to risk of non-delivery or wrong item.

proof_requests: Photo of the monitor itself, showing front, back, and model number.
Photo or video of the monitor turned on, showing screen and settings menu.
Photo of the monitor's specifications label or user manual if available.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Xiaomi 30-inch curved gaming monitor from the box, but key claims like 200Hz refresh rate and 21.9 aspect ratio are unverifiable from the photos. The monitor itself is not shown, so condition, functionality, and model accuracy are unknown. Proof is needed to confirm specifications and condition before pricing.
